source: historical Steer campaign main1000_w050; not R05 generated data

family_ranking.geometric_statistical_unit: One exact-copy state family per event, then equal generation batches
family_ranking.credit_rule: Pool all observed descendant graphs before ranking teacher geometry; extinct families remain unknown
family_ranking.label_rule: Decoded final valid-molecule score mean per chemical graph, then equal-graph mean per observed ancestor; no best-copy score

support_and_limits.interpretation: Teacher selection changes were observed in 26/714 historical batch-event cells, concentrated late in the window. This diagnoses a ranking difference; it does not show that family-mean ranking improves prospective affinity.
support_and_limits.censoring: Extinct families have unknown futures; lineage clones, family members, and repeated event times are not independent observations.
support_and_limits.scope: No reward formula or parameters were changed by this diagnostic. R05 metrics are available, but this note makes no R06 design or inference choice.
